name: ANEST IWATA Corporation
summary: ANEST IWATA Corporation operates air energy and coating business in Japan, Europe, the United States, China, and internationally. It engages in manufacturing and sales of air compressors, vacuum equipment, coating equipment and systems, and installment equipment. The company offers coating/paint application equipment, which includes spray guns, electrostatic coating machines, and paint supply equipment for industrial and automotive industries; and automatic painting and environmental devices, painting plants and robots, and painting booths.
